Without windowing, or when the signal is discontinuous at the frame boundary, spectral leakage appears as burrs spreading to both sides of what should be a single peak; windowing and taking a long enough frame for a steady signal suppress it. Transient signals inherently have broadband content, so judge them together with the time domain.
